name: K380 Fn-Lock
description: Battery level and Fn lock switching for the Logitech K380 Bluetooth keyboard, right from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Shown while the K380 is connected. Left click opens the keyboard panel; right click switches Fn lock between Media and Function keys.

schema.label: Show mode label
schema.description: Show Media or Fn next to the bar icon.

schema.label: Bluetooth address
